children: India's automobile retail sales rose 17.5% year-on-year in August, driven by stronger demand for two-wheelers and passenger vehicles, the Federation of Automobile Dealers Associations said on Monday.
Dealers sold a total of 2.4 million vehicles during the month, compared with 2.6 million units in July, the industry body said.
